sections: Who we are and what these terms are

Kalend is an Android app provided by {{SELLER}} ({{ADDRESS}}, {{EMAIL}}). Purchases are made through Google Play and are also subject to the Google Play terms, including its refund policy. By using the app you accept these terms.
Licence

We grant you a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to use Kalend on the devices linked to your Google Play account. You may not redistribute, sell, decompile or modify the app, except where the law allows it.
How it works and where your data lives

Kalend works on your device. There are no accounts and no servers of ours: events, tasks, settings and keys stay on your phone. You are responsible for the content you enter and for your backups; the app provides backup and export tools.
Third-party services

Some features use third-party services: weather (MET Norway by default), place search (GeoNames, Photon on OpenStreetMap data), calendars you link yourself (Google, Microsoft, Apple or others) and, if you choose them, services with your own key (Open‑Meteo, OpenWeatherMap). They are provided by their operators under their own terms, may change or end without notice, and Kalend is not a party to them. Any cost of personal keys is between you and the provider.
Information is indicative

Weather forecasts, holidays, religious dates, calendar conversions, astronomical calculations and reminders are indicative. Do not rely on Kalend as the only reference for decisions concerning safety, health or legal deadlines. Notifications depend on the operating system (battery, power-saving modes, permissions) and may be late or missing.
Warranty and liability

Kalend is provided "as is" to the extent permitted by law. If you are a consumer, the mandatory guarantees of your country's law remain unaffected (for example the conformity guarantee for digital content in the European Union). To the extent permitted, we exclude liability for indirect damage, lost profit and data loss, and our total liability is limited to what you paid for the app in the previous 12 months, except in cases of wilful misconduct, gross negligence or where the law does not allow limitations.
Updates and changes
We may update the app and these terms. Material changes are announced in the app; by continuing to use it after the notice you accept them. You can stop at any time by uninstalling the app.
Intellectual property

The app, its graphics and texts belong to us or to their respective owners. Third-party data and fonts are used under their licences, listed in the credits. Names of other products and services are mentioned only to describe compatibility.
Governing law and venue

These terms are governed by {{LAW}} law. If you are a consumer, you keep the protections and the venue provided by the law of the country where you live. In the European Union you may also use the Commission's online dispute resolution platform.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
sections: In short

Kalend collects no data about you: no account, no advertising, no tracking, no usage statistics, no servers of ours. Everything you enter stays on your device. Some features, if you use them, send the minimum necessary to third-party services, described below.
Who is responsible
{{SELLER}}, {{ADDRESS}}, {{EMAIL}}. We neither receive nor process your personal data: it never reaches us.
Data that stays on the device

Events, tasks, chains, lists, tags, settings, automatic backups, places you have searched, personal keys and links of connected calendars (the last two encrypted with a key that never leaves the phone).
What leaves the phone and to whom

Only when you use the feature: • Weather: coordinates rounded to about 1 km go to the weather service you chose (MET Norway, Norway, by default); the provider sees your IP address like any server you contact. • Places: the text of the place you search goes to Photon (komoot, Germany) on OpenStreetMap data, only if the atlas on the phone does not know it. • Services with your own key (Open‑Meteo, OpenWeatherMap): coordinates or place text together with your key, under the policy of the provider you chose. • Connected calendars: the link you entered is downloaded from its operator (Google, Microsoft, Apple or others). • "Open in Google Calendar": the data of the event you choose to open goes to Google. • Dictation: the system's speech recognition runs on the phone when available; otherwise the system's voice service may send audio to its provider's servers (for example Google) under its own policy. Kalend does not record or keep audio. • QR sync: data travels directly between your devices on the local network, with no server.
Permissions

Location (optional, only while the app is open): for sky, sunrise, sunset and weather where you are. Microphone (optional): to dictate events. Phone calendar (optional): to read those events next to yours; Kalend does not modify them. Notifications and exact alarms: for reminders at the time you choose. Every permission can be denied or revoked in the system settings.
Backups

Android may include the app's data in the system backup (Google Drive), encrypted with your screen lock and managed by Google under its own policy; personal keys and encrypted links are excluded. Manual exports, plain or password-protected, are decided and kept by you.
Retention and deletion
Data stays as long as you keep the app. You can delete everything from Settings → Data or by uninstalling the app. There are no copies with us.
Children
The app is not intended for children under 13 (or the age set by local law) and collects no data in any case.
Your rights

Data protection laws (for example the GDPR) grant you access, rectification, erasure, portability and the right to complain to a supervisory authority. Since the data lives only on your device, you exercise these rights directly there; for third-party services, contact their providers. Any question: {{EMAIL}}.
Changes
Last updated: {{UPDATED}}. The version in force is the one shown in the app and published online.

location: Kalend uses your location, only while the app is open, to show the sky, sunrise, sunset and weather where you are. Coordinates rounded to about 1 km are sent to the weather service you chose (MET Norway by default). No other use, no sharing.
mic: The microphone is used only to dictate events. Recognition runs on the phone when available; otherwise the system's voice service may send audio to its provider's servers. Kalend does not record or keep audio.
calendar: Kalend reads the events of your phone calendar to show them next to yours. It does not modify them and sends them to no one.
notif: Notifications are used for event reminders at the time you choose. You can turn them off whenever you want.
speechCloud: On-device speech recognition is not available on this phone: dictation uses the system's voice service, which may send audio to its provider's servers (for example Google) under that provider's privacy policy. Kalend never records or stores audio. You can install the language for offline use in the phone's voice settings, or type the event instead.
